prompt: Rendered in the style of an oil painting, this scene captures a bustling subway platform where thick brushstrokes define the gritty atmosphere. On the left stands a woman in a yellow raincoat holding a folded umbrella tightly against her chest. Next to her sits a man in a blue suit resting his head on his hand in exhaustion. In the center, a teenager with purple hair leans casually against a tiled pillar while scrolling through a phone. Beside the teenager, an elderly man in a gray coat points toward the dark tunnel entrance with a wrinkled finger. A brown dog on a leash sniffs the shoe of the elderly man, creating a small moment of connection amidst the rush. To the right, a musician in a black hat strums an acoustic guitar with focused intensity. A little girl in a pink dress looks up at the musician with wide eyes, captivated by the melody. Behind them, a businessman in a striped tie checks his wristwatch impatiently. Near the edge of the platform, a tourist with a large backpack takes a photo of the arriving train lights. A street vendor in an apron hands a warm pretzel to a commuter in a green jacket who reaches out eagerly. The peeling paint on the walls suggests age and neglect. There is no digital advertisement screen visible on the walls. There is no modern smartphone held by the elderly man.
